title: Overseer review report v1

$schema.description: Identifies the versioned Overseer report schema.

schema_version.description: Report format version; consumers must support this version.

generated_at.description: UTC time when this report was written.

commit_sha.description: Reviewed source revision, or null when unavailable.

path.description: Path supplied for the reviewed matrix file.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact matrix file bytes, including line endings.

version.description: Optional user-defined matrix revision tag from YAML; omitted for unversioned matrices. Independent of schema_version.

matrix.description: Identity of the matrix captured before generation.

expected_case_count.description: Number of cases expanded from the matrix, including unreviewed cases.

completed_case_count.description: Number of fully reviewed cases, including failed or skipped reviews.

complete.description: Whether every expected case has a completed review.

successful.description: True only for a nonempty matrix whose cases and checklist items all passed.

passed.description: Completed cases in which every checklist item passed.

failed.description: Cases with at least one failed checklist item.

skipped.description: Cases with skipped or missing answers and no failed answers.

error.description: Cases stopped by a terminal generator error.

pending.description: Expected cases without a recorded review or terminal generator error.

summary.description: Exclusive case counts by final status; these sum to expected_case_count.

cases.description: All expected cases in matrix order, including errors and pending reviews.

description: Versioned human review results. Schema validation checks structure; CI checks provenance and review policy separately.

index.description: Zero-based index in the expanded matrix.

params.description: Resolved scalar parameter values for this case.

artifact_path.description: Generated artifact path, or null when no review result was recorded.

retry_count.description: Number of retries before the recorded outcome.

completed.description: Whether the reviewer finished the entire case.

status.description: Exclusive outcome: failure takes precedence over skipped answers; interrupted cases cannot pass.

error.description: Terminal generator error message, or null.

verdict.description: Recorded answer; null means no answer was recorded.

checklist.description: Checklist items in matrix order with recorded answers.
